+from typing import Annotated, Union, Any
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Json
+from fastapi._compat.v2 import ModelField
+from fastapi.params import Form
+from starlette.datastructures import ImmutableMultiDict
+from fastapi._compat.v2 import is_sequence_field
+
+def get_validation_alias(field):
+    return field.alias
+
+def _get_multidict_value(
+    field: ModelField, values: Mapping[str, Any], alias: Union[str, None] = None
+) -> Any:
+    alias = alias or get_validation_alias(field)
+    if is_sequence_field(field) and isinstance(values, (ImmutableMultiDict,)):
+        # Pydantic v2: Json[T] fields have Json in metadata.
+        # We want to treat them as scalars (single string) even if T is a sequence.
+        if hasattr(field.field_info, "metadata") and field.field_info.metadata:
+            from pydantic import Json as PydanticJson
+            if PydanticJson in field.field_info.metadata:
+                value = values.get(alias, None)
+            else:
+                value = values.getlist(alias)
+        else:
+            value = values.getlist(alias)
+    else:
+        value = values.get(alias, None)
+    return value
+
+class MyModel(BaseModel):
+    tags: Annotated[Json[list[str]], Form()]
+    items: Annotated[list[str], Form()]
+
+field_info_tags = MyModel.model_fields['tags']
+model_field_tags = ModelField(field_info=field_info_tags, name='tags')
+
+field_info_items = MyModel.model_fields['items']
+model_field_items = ModelField(field_info=field_info_items, name='items')
+
+values = ImmutableMultiDict([("tags", '["abc", "def"]'), ("items", "abc"), ("items", "def")])
+
+print(f"Tags value: { _get_multidict_value(model_field_tags, values)}")
+print(f"Items value: { _get_multidict_value(model_field_items, values)}")

+from typing import Annotated, Union, Any
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Json
+from fastapi._compat.v2 import ModelField
+from fastapi.params import Form
+from starlette.datastructures import ImmutableMultiDict
+from fastapi._compat.v2 import is_sequence_field
+
+def get_validation_alias(field):
+    return field.alias
+
+def _get_multidict_value(
+    field: ModelField, values: Mapping[str, Any], alias: Union[str, None] = None
+) -> Any:
+    alias = alias or get_validation_alias(field)
+    print(f"DEBUG: field={field.name}, is_sequence={is_sequence_field(field)}, metadata={getattr(field.field_info, 'metadata', None)}")
+    if is_sequence_field(field) and isinstance(values, (ImmutableMultiDict,)):
+        # Pydantic v2: Json[T] fields have Json in metadata.
+        # We want to treat them as scalars (single string) even if T is a sequence.
+        if hasattr(field.field_info, "metadata") and field.field_info.metadata:
+            from pydantic import Json as PydanticJson
+            print(f"DEBUG: PydanticJson={PydanticJson}, metadata={field.field_info.metadata}")
+            if PydanticJson in field.field_info.metadata:
+                print("DEBUG: is_json_field=True")
+                value = values.get(alias, None)
+            else:
+                print("DEBUG: is_json_field=False (not in metadata)")
+                value = values.getlist(alias)
+        else:
+            print("DEBUG: no metadata")
+            value = values.getlist(alias)
+    else:
+        print("DEBUG: not sequence or not ImmutableMultiDict")
+        value = values.get(alias, None)
+    return value
+
+class MyModel(BaseModel):
+    tags: Annotated[Json[list[str]], Form()]
+    items: Annotated[list[str], Form()]
+
+field_info_tags = MyModel.model_fields['tags']
+model_field_tags = ModelField(field_info=field_info_tags, name='tags')
+
+field_info_items = MyModel.model_fields['items']
+model_field_items = ModelField(field_info=field_info_items, name='items')
+
+values = ImmutableMultiDict([("tags", '["abc", "def"]'), ("items", "abc"), ("items", "def")])
+
+print(f"Tags value: { _get_multidict_value(model_field_tags, values)}")
+print(f"Items value: { _get_multidict_value(model_field_items, values)}")
